skills.title: Including and Respecting Everyone
skills.description: Being inclusive, respectful, and accepting helps everyone, including you. Pick actions that make others feel welcome and tell how they help.

skills.title: Effects of Drugs and Substances
skills.description: Cannabis, opioids, other drugs, and things like glue or gas can harm the body and mind in many ways. Match each kind of substance to its effects.

skills.title: Finding Mental Health Support
skills.description: Many people and places can help with mental health or substance use, like counsellors, help lines, and public health units. Pick who can help and how to reach them.

skills.title: Thoughts, Feelings, and Actions Link
skills.description: Your thoughts, feelings, and actions are all connected. Positive thinking can help your mind, and negative thinking can hurt it.

skills.title: What Shapes Our Food Choices
skills.description: Allergies, likes, stress, cost, culture, media, and the Earth can all change what we eat. Match each factor to how it affects healthy eating choices.

skills.title: Hunger Cues and Growing Bodies
skills.description: Growth spurts, being active, and big portions change how hungry or thirsty you feel. Match each one to how it changes what your body needs.

skills.title: Getting Along and Solving Conflict
skills.description: Listening, speaking up kindly, and calming your anger help you avoid or handle conflict, in person or online. Pick the best skill for each situation.

skills.title: Making Safe Choices About Drugs
skills.description: Values, friends, media, curiosity, laws, and beliefs all shape choices about alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, and vaping. Use decision steps to pick safe choices, including saying no.

skills.title: Healthy Eating and Active Living
skills.description: Eating well and being active work together to give you energy, a strong body, and a good mood. Match the benefits to each and pick ways to encourage others.

skills.title: Staying Safe When Caring for Others
skills.description: Babysitting, staying home alone, cooking, and caring for pets have risks. Pick safe practices and what to do in emergencies like fires, allergic reactions, or hurt people.
